ntpdate_use_ntp_conf.description: Set to 'yes' to take the server list from /etc/ntpsec/ntp.conf

ntpdate_servers.description: List of NTP servers to use. Not used if ntpdate_use_ntp_conf is yes.

ntpdate_options.description: Additional options to pass to ntpdate

ntpdate_ignore_dhcp.description: Set to 'yes' to ignore NTP servers returned by DHCP.
